remarks: First time on market! This 1993 center hall colonial is private and located in the popular Thunder Lake neighborhood where people enjoy walking, running and riding bikes. Upon entering the home, you will be captivated by the front to back living room and dining room with large bay windows offering beautiful views and an abundance of light. The eat- in kitchen is a chefs delight with stainless steel appliances, granite counters which opens to a family room with fireplace and sliders to the outdoor deck, perfect for entertaining a large group of friends and family. Hall bath and first floor laundry complete the main level. Upstairs you will find a spacious primary bedroom with full bath and walk in closet plus 3 additional bedrooms and full hall bath. In addition, there is a large multi-purpose bonus room with endless possibilities. Other features of the home include a finished lower level and storage, plus hardwood floors, central air and a two-car garage. This colonial was lovingly maintained and cared for by its original owners with beautiful gardens, deck, gazebo and gorgeous property. Minutes to train, schools and shopping, plus easy access to Georgetown,Wilton and Ridgefield town centers. Book your appointment now. This property is not to be missed!
